 Kennedy & Johnson LLP
 Sugar Land, TX
 Phone 832-555-5054
 Letter of Representation
6 Mar 2025
Claims Department
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Re: Claim C-1355
Our client: Leah Bowen
Date of loss: 3 Mar 2025
Dear Claims Representative:
I represent the injured party in connection with the sideswipe collision that occurred while our client was changing lanes. Please
direct all further communication regarding this matter to this office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone,
mail, or in person. If your insured or any representative has already been in contact with our client, please note that our client is
now represented and any future inquiries should be routed to us.
We request that you disclose the bodily injury and property damage liability limits under the policy issued to your insured for this
loss, along with confirmation of any other coverage that may apply, including umbrella or excess policies. Please provide this
information in writing within fifteen days of receipt of this letter.
We also ask that your company preserve all evidence relating to this incident. This includes the claim file, photographs, recorded
statements, telematics or dashcam data, vehicle inspection and repair records, adjuster notes, and any communications with your
insured or third parties. Routine destruction or alteration of any such material should be suspedned until this matter is fully
resolved.
Sincerely,
David Richardson
Kennedy & Johnson LLP
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
